title: Maritime Deficiency Disposition Plan Reconstruction
dataset: USCG PSIX inspection, deficiency and operational-control exports
compute: CPU; final temporal baseline completes in about 338 seconds
reuse_basis: USCG policy permits copying and distribution of information in its public non-logged-in domain. Not a CC license. Scope to agency public records, retain notices, exclude third-party protected materials and do not imply endorsement. Check export-specific notices before redistribution.
public_source_lookup_gate: waived explicitly by user; residual risk must remain documented
readiness_note: The original activity-level operational-control formulation remains rejected. The approved redesign uses native deficiency-level action and authority labels, removes 150 historically unsupported rare-label rows, groups 67,416 items into 16,564 train and 3,768 hidden temporal-test inspection plans, exposes only opaque taxonomy and privacy-transformed tokens, and passes deterministic preparation, grader, leakage, source-retrieval, metric-null, baseline-headroom, source-package, novelty, and import-route gates.

latest_audit.strict_commercial_redistribution_license: U.S. Government Work / Public Domain under 17 U.S.C. 105 with official distribution permission; protected branding excluded

redesign_pilot.proposed_target: inspection-level deficiency disposition plan using native Action and Action Code labels
redesign_pilot.external_source_status: Hold pending account, exact schema/count, taxonomy mapping, and express commercial redistribution permission

evidence.license: U.S. Government Work / Public Domain; 17 U.S.C. 105 plus official non-logged-in distribution permission; protected branding excluded
evidence.lookup_attack: Opaque IDs, taxonomy, labels, and privacy-transformed text; conservative decoded-taxonomy attack has 0.066% unique-row and 0.074% unanimous-target recovery
evidence.strongest_baseline: privacy-token word/character TF-IDF LinearSVC, score 0.312803 on 2025 temporal test, about 338 seconds

raw_size_policy: Prefer below 1 GB; target below 3 GB; never exceed 5 GB. Untouched official raw files only; transformations in prepare.py.
